info.title: Faite internal API
info.description: Every route this Worker actually serves: /api/sync/* (the CRDT replication protocol — internal, never a stable public contract), /api/places/*, /api/desktop/*, /api/email/*, /api/contact, and /api/auth/* (merged from Better Auth's own openAPI() plugin). Also carries the entity schemas the public surface (openapi/v1.json) will reference as /api/v1 grows. Generated by scripts/openapi/generate.ts — do not hand-edit.

get.description: Requires the `Upgrade: websocket` header. A server push (e.g. an API write) broadcasts to every device connected here.

101.description: Switching Protocols — the WebSocket is open.

401.description: No session and no valid API key.

403.description: Origin not on the CORS allow-list (`forbidden-origin`), OR a valid API key without the `sync` scope (`insufficient-scope`, A2, EI-227).

426.description: Request did not carry a WebSocket upgrade.

post.summary: Push local outbox entries — the CRDT write path.
post.description: A write here is a push, not a database write: every entry goes through `UserDurableObject.push()`, which allocates a `version` and field-level HLC clocks atomically. See docs/API.md and docs/SYNC.md.

400.description: Malformed request — bad protocol version, too many entries, or a malformed entry.

401.description: No session and no valid API key.

403.description: A valid API key without the required scope (A2, EI-227). A cookie session or a full desktop-handoff key never sees this.

500.description: Unhandled server error.

post.description: Called from the system browser with a live cookie session. Mints a real, full-session-equivalent API key and returns an encrypted code — never the key itself.
